newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts face steep losses if 112-18 fails.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts face steep losses if 112-18 fails.

text.p: LIFFE September gilt futures must stay above 112-18, 22 to retain their gains at the end of last week. Failure to hold this level could force the market down to 112-05 and even lower, analysts said on Monday.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst, said a breach of 112-18 from the outset on Monday would signal losses to the bottom of the market's recent range of between 112-00 and 111-20.
"The French result and the way the Bunds are going will favour the downside at the moment," Wood said.
By 0705 GMT, September gilts were up 2/32 at 112-30.
